item.name: Mana Draught

effects.title: Bottoms Up
effects.text:
Restores 70 + 3% of the caster's maximum mana over 6 seconds. If the hero is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

Hold Control to use on an allied hero.

effects.title: Fill Up
effects.text: Cooldown Speed of Mana Draught is increased by 30% while in water.

item.lore: A refreshing drink best shared with friends.
